daedalus/shift_ticker.py: Renders shift status, remaining time, and checkpoints for human viewing in a terminal.
daedalus/structcore/metrics.py: Computes per-file code health metrics including LOC, function count, comment density, guard density, long functions, and lizard complexity if available.
risks: CLAIMS|daedalus/shift_ticker.py|This is the HUMAN's view. It prints the time, the declared goal, how much of the window is left, and the checkpoints the agent has written.

CLAIMS|daedalus/structcore/metrics.py|Per-file health metrics — the 'code health' signal, comment-aware per language. Stdlib-only baseline... If lizard is installed, real cyclomatic complexity is added.
todos: daedalus/shift_ticker.py|function|render|Returns a formatted string showing shift status.
